test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Eight girls Q, R, S, T, U, V, W and X were sitting around a square table, facing the centre. Some of them were sitting at the corners, while some were sitting at the exact centre of the sides. Only V was sitting between R and S. Q and T were immediate neighbours. Only X was sitting between T and S. U was sitting to the immediate right of Q. S was sitting fourth to the left of U. S is sitting at one of the corners. Who was sitting fourth to the left of X?
solution:
**Given:** Eight girls Q, R, S, T, U, V, W and X were sitting around a square table, facing the centre. 

S is sitting at one of the corners

1) Only V was sitting between R and S. 

2) Q and T were immediate neighbours. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf7398d4ea0bf7cc23b9c4eca01946bb0fddf578b76c90bd0f06a5460bea7e6f.png] 

3) Only X was sitting between T and S. 

4) U was sitting to the immediate right of Q. 

5) S was sitting fourth to the left of U. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/096ec1b89cf1781d3d501551f9387a6467003a7d114ed98e7eaccac3779321a4.png] 

So,** W sits fourth to the left of X**

Hence the correct answer is** "Option 3".**
